setup.mock_latency: WireMock chunked dribble: first chunk (holding the first token) after 300 ms, then 10 more chunks every 100 ms, last at 1.3 s; scenario 7 uses a 5.1 s stream (first chunk at 300 ms, 25 chunks every 200 ms); scenario 7b holds the Claude response headers for 20 s
setup.notes: scenario 1: a 20s gateway warm-up at 20/s ran first and is not reported | scenario 1: 11001 requests through the gateway and 11000 straight to the mock, each at 100/s for 110s (constant-arrival-rate); added latency = gateway minus direct, per percentile, k6 client-side (ttfb = http_req_waiting, total = http_req_duration); gateway processing overhead = gateway_overhead_seconds histogram over the gateway leg, interpolated within buckets (edges 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000 ms) | scenario 1: the rate limiter or budget check failed open 0 times during the gateway leg (Redis command timeout 50 ms, D-17; Redis shares the CPUs) | scenario 8: gateway_requestlog_write_seconds over the scenario 1 gateway leg, interpolated within buckets (edges 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100 ms) | scenario 2: total time of responses marked X-Gateway-Cache: HIT, k6 client-side, open load 50/s over a warmed pool of 20 temperature-0 prompts; 0 responses in the load phase were not hits | scenario 3: hit rate from request_log.cache_status of the run's own tenant; response headers counted 481 hits, request_log 481 | scenario 4: SUM(request_log.cost_usd) / requests x 1,000 per run, one fresh tenant per run; baseline: 0 cache hits, 0 on claude-haiku-5-5, cache: 480 cache hits, 0 on claude-haiku-5-5, routing: 0 cache hits, 800 on claude-haiku-5-5, both: 480 cache hits, 800 on claude-haiku-5-5; list prices of 2026-11-16 | scenario 5: open load 20/s for 60s; mock-claude killed (docker kill, SIGKILL) at the stated second, the command took 297 ms; requests are classed by their start time; added latency = successful after-kill minus successful before-kill, per percentile, k6 client-side; 705 of 705 successful after-kill requests were served by ollama; 20 requests started before the kill failed (in flight when it happened) | scenario 6: open load 10/s for 120 s on a tenant with 20000 tokens/min; request_log: 1032 rows with 429, 169 with 200, 0 other; k6 saw 1032 429s; admitted tokens/min = billed input+output tokens of 200 rows logged from second 60 to 120 after the first row (the bucket starts full, so the first minute also admits the initial capacity) | scenario 6b refused: 2986 requests started, 2986 completed with [DONE], 0 ended at k6's 60 s request timeout with no response, 0 were still running when k6's 60 s graceful stop ended; k6 dropped 14 scheduled arrivals (no free VU, so the arrival rate was not held) | scenario 6b blackholed: 1657 requests started, 271 completed with [DONE], 1385 ended at k6's 60 s request timeout with no response, 1 were still running when k6's 60 s graceful stop ended; k6 dropped 1344 scheduled arrivals (no free VU, so the arrival rate was not held); the p50/p95/p99 added latency is capped by that timeout (a lower bound: those requests waited at least that long) | scenario 6b: the scenario 1 gateway load at 100/s for 30s, app started with Redis stopped (refused) and with REDIS_HOST=172.17.255.254 (a connect attempt timed out after 1.0 s with no answer: black-holed); added = total time (http_req_duration, every request that ended, k6 timeouts included) minus scenario 1's gateway leg, per percentile, k6 client-side; errors = requests started minus requests completed with [DONE] | scenario 7 N=500: 2000 streams started, 0 not completed; 48 heap samples, 12 thread dumps | scenario 7 N=1000: 4000 streams started, 0 not completed; 47 heap samples, 12 thread dumps | scenario 7 N=2000: 6163 streams started, 0 not completed; 39 heap samples, 13 thread dumps | scenario 7 N=4000: 4000 streams started, 4000 not completed; left out of runs because its peak heap and virtual threads could not be sampled: the app threw OutOfMemoryError (heap -Xmx512m); the app stopped answering and was restarted after the step; 3 heap/thread samples failed (5 heap samples and 1 thread dumps succeeded);
